title: "GDBuddy: Hardware-in-the-Loop GitHub Actions Runner for Embedded Devices"

abstract: |
  Hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) testing provides a one-to-one representation of real-world embedded system behavior, something simulation alone cannot fully capture, but it is rarely integrated into continuous integration (CI) workflows due to hardware accessibility and automation challenges. This work introduces GDBuddy, a Hardware-in-the-Loop CI framework that enables automated execution of embedded code on physical microcontroller hardware through a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner. GDBuddy bridges cloud-based CI infrastructure with a physical execution layer by deploying compiled firmware to a Raspberry Pi Pico WH or Arduino Uno over a USB interface and capturing runtime output for evaluation. The system is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing GitHub development workflows, allowing embedded systems to be tested using the same mechanisms commonly employed in modern software engineering practices. By leveraging containerization, GDBuddy ensures consistent runtime environments across executions, isolates untrusted code from the host system, and reduces variability caused by differences in local development setups. This approach improves reproducibility while also enabling controlled access to physical hardware resources. Unlike simulation-based approaches, GDBuddy exposes hardware-specific behaviors such as timing variability, peripheral interactions, and device-level constraints that are often not captured in emulated environments. This enables more realistic validation of embedded programs and helps identify issues that would otherwise remain undetected until deployment on physical devices, which is often a manual and inconsistent process in traditional workflows. By automating this process within a CI pipeline, GDBuddy extends standard software engineering practices to embedded systems development, enabling more reliable testing, faster feedback cycles, and improved confidence in system behavior prior to deployment.
